brief_rationale: The trajectory demonstrates comprehensive responsibility-chain completion with no safety errors. All minimum duties for risk clarification, red-flag screening, history reconciliation, preoperative checklists, and postoperative monitoring were met across multiple turns. Four high-order points were triggered and actively completed with meaningful trajectory impact: patient-state-sensitive communication using appropriate analogies and non-alarmist framing (HO1), real-world constraint navigation with practical bedside communication strategies (HO2), hidden-state discovery of family dynamics and patient autonomy (HO3), and safe bounded closure distinguishing urgent vs. allowable uncertainties (HO4).

citations.explanation: Final doctor message provides comprehensive closure with complete red-flag lists for both local (finger/wound) and systemic (DVT/PE) complications, follow-up timing, and explicit acknowledgment of episode completion

closure_assessment.explanation: Episode concluded with family discharged, post-discharge monitoring plan in place, pathology follow-up scheduled, and clear emergency criteria. All allowed residual risks (pathology pending, functional recovery uncertain) appropriately carried forward. No blocking residual risks remain.
